rules.last_session: PROVISIONAL: touched threads and standalone beats with narrative_impact and lasting_consequence both medium or high; story order; no cap
rules.want: serves_thread is null (an end, not a means) and significance is not incidental (Goals: parent_goal_id null, significance not incidental)
rules.owe: definite_end; commitment_type is not general_agreement; stake, burden and consequence are not trivial (Obligations filter)
rules.blocked_by: active, persists beyond the scene, not covered by immediate danger, and blocks a thread holding a shown want, debt or opening
rules.could_use: helps_thread names a thread whose want or debt is shown, directly or through a parent thread (Opportunities and New Assets need a goal link); role is direct (Opportunities: parent_opportunity_id null); an opening needs action_supported yes; a pointer is hidden only when a selected home fact has the same resource_subject, form, helped thread, full text and uncertainty; an asset with low or trivial goal_support is shown only if acquired by acting on an opening (New Assets filter)
rules.unknown: question_type open_ended and all four dimensions medium or high (Mysteries filter)
rules.threat: harm_origin is not party and no evaluation is low (Brewing Troubles filter); not covered by an immediate danger
rules.all: never possibly moot facts; no caps

last_session_candidates.change: The undead swordsman was identified as Sir Alfred, who was incapacitated but left undestroyed in the Barrow Mound.
last_session_candidates.impact_basis: The combat beats identify Sir Alfred, and Ned's wasp disabled him, ending the immediate threat.
last_session_candidates.lasting_basis: The party left Sir Alfred incapacitated rather than destroyed, so he could return, though they have moved on from the barrow.

last_session_candidates.change: The party gained allies, mithril armor, a plan to drug the dragon with faun wine and the lair's location, but found no remedy for its poison and began to suspect there may be no dragon at all.
last_session_candidates.impact_basis: Vivian's faun-wine plan, Malzazarik and Hilda joining, the lair read on the map, and Vivian's admission she has no venom cure clearly changed the dragon hunt.
last_session_candidates.lasting_basis: The faun-wine strategy, new allies, the lair's location and Dunk's theory that Bral is faking the dragon will shape the coming confrontation.

last_session_candidates.change: Drop Dead Ned's wasp incapacitated Sir Alfred.
last_session_candidates.impact_basis: A single beat shows Ned's jar-wasp disabling Sir Alfred, which demonstrated his usefulness but did not change his offer.
last_session_candidates.lasting_basis: Ned remains with the party and his offers still stand, but nothing new was agreed.

last_session_candidates.change: The goblins' deal was renegotiated so they wall off the stairs and keep the upper rooms, Wayman promised never to tell King Hogboon where they are, and the party found Hogboon's goblin castle.
last_session_candidates.impact_basis: Beats show the new terms, the goblins' vow to destroy the church, Wayman's promise, and the discovery of Hogboon's temple-castle.
last_session_candidates.lasting_basis: The promise to Snurk is still owed, and the goblin state and Hogboon's castle are likely to recur.

last_session_candidates.change: Dr. Uriah promised to return the barrow robes to the church after the dragon is defeated, and the robes proved to be non-magical relics.
last_session_candidates.impact_basis: Brother Dirk's dispute with Uriah ended in an agreement, and witch powder showed the robes have no magic.
last_session_candidates.lasting_basis: The promise to return the robes after the dragon is defeated is owed and is likely to come up again.

last_session_candidates.change: The party learned their map came from Bral, identified the Dragon's Lair and the Dwarven mine on it, and heard from Grimny that the hoard is probably hidden in the Dragon's Lair.
last_session_candidates.impact_basis: Beats reveal the map's origin (won from Bral), read two locations, and Grimny points to the Dragon's Lair as the hoard's likely hiding place, answering central questions.
last_session_candidates.lasting_basis: The hoard's likely location and the unidentified third site direct where the party goes next.

last_session_candidates.change: Warwick lent the party his mithril chain shirt, holding the plate armor and the lyre as collateral, in exchange for metal from the Dwarven mine.
last_session_candidates.impact_basis: Beats show the deal struck, collateral handed over, and Wayman wearing the shirt, which greatly improves his protection and halves magic damage.
last_session_candidates.lasting_basis: The party owes Warwick metal from the mine and must eventually return the shirt to reclaim their collateral.

last_session_candidates.change: Cedric and Warwick confirmed that supplies and metal stopped arriving when the dragon troubles began.
last_session_candidates.impact_basis: Cedric's and Warwick's statements tie the halted shipments to the dragon, partly answering why shipments stopped.
last_session_candidates.lasting_basis: The link makes defeating the dragon the way to restore the town's trade, which is likely to come up again.

last_session_candidates.change: Cedric signed a promissory note for the barrow treasure, worth 975 gold, payable once the caravans flow, and the party used it to recruit allies.
last_session_candidates.impact_basis: The note converted the treasure into a future claim and funded Malzazarik and Hilda joining, a meaningful resource change.
last_session_candidates.lasting_basis: Payment depends on the caravans resuming and the note is pledged to the new allies, so it will matter later.

last_session_candidates.change: Lady Hilda and the wizard Malzazarik joined the party, recruited against Cedric's promissory note.
last_session_candidates.impact_basis: Beat records both recruits joining on the strength of the promissory note, giving the party two major allies.
last_session_candidates.lasting_basis: Two new party members will take part in later Sessions, and their pay under the note remains owed.

last_session_candidates.change: Sir Phidipaldi told Ingrid that Warwick knows about her nighttime visits and is not interested, leaving her crestfallen.
last_session_candidates.impact_basis: Phidipaldi's revelation to Ingrid and her hurt reaction changed the situation, and the shirt was obtained without her potion.
last_session_candidates.lasting_basis: Ingrid's feelings toward the party may matter later and Dunk's promise to her is unreleased, but the potion plan is largely moot.

last_session_candidates.change: The party learned Ingrid's wares: wolfsbane essence, witch powder and Mandrake root tea.
last_session_candidates.impact_basis: The beat only lists ordinary shop goods and prices.
last_session_candidates.lasting_basis: Knowing where to buy these consumables is a minor convenience.

last_session_candidates.change: Party members bought Mandrake root teas and Essences of Wolfsbane.
last_session_candidates.impact_basis: The beat records a purchase of ordinary consumables.
last_session_candidates.lasting_basis: The ordinary purchases may be used later but matter little.

last_session_candidates.change: Dunk delivered Vivian's love letter and scent to Grimny's ghost, who ascended in elation.
last_session_candidates.impact_basis: The errand was accepted and completed this Session, giving Grimny's ghost rest.
last_session_candidates.lasting_basis: The thread is resolved and nothing remains owed, though Vivian may later learn the outcome.

last_session_candidates.change: Dunk took a magical ring from a dead dwarf and put it on, which let him see and speak with Grimny's ghost.
last_session_candidates.impact_basis: Beats show the ring found, identified as magical and of unknown curse status, and used to contact Grimny.
last_session_candidates.lasting_basis: Dunk still wears the possibly cursed ring, whose powers are likely to come up again.

last_session_candidates.change: Grimny's ghost revealed that his brother Bral, the greediest of seven dwarf brothers, killed him, and Dunk suspected Bral may be faking the dragon.
last_session_candidates.impact_basis: Grimny's account names Bral as murderer and links him to the treasure map, and Dunk's theory recasts the dragon threat, introducing a major foe.
last_session_candidates.lasting_basis: Bral's whereabouts, the fate of the other dwarves and whether the dragon is real will shape later Sessions.
